---
title: "Évolution de la qualité de l'air"
format: dashboard
filters:
  - shinylive

---


```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
#| include: false

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

  iqa <- readRDS("./data/donnees_iqa.rds")

```


## Row {height=60%}

```{r}
#| title: Iqa moyen toutes région

iqa |>
  filter(type == "station") |>
   ggplot() +
   geom_point(mapping = (aes(x=date, y=iqa_moyen))) 
  
```

## Row {height=40%}

```{r}
#| title: IQA minimal par région
iqa |>
   filter(type == "region") |>
   ggplot() +
   geom_point(mapping = (aes(x=date, y=min_iqa))) 
```

```{r}
#| title: IQA maximal par région
iqa |>
   filter(type == "region") |>
   ggplot() +
   geom_point(mapping = (aes(x=date, y=max_iqa))) 
```
